label: D2: chose a2 but landed in S1 (rare a2->S1), when the policy is not strongly committed to a2
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only on rare transitions after choosing a2 (in_action=a2, in_state=S1): (D2 & action==2 & state==1) covers 100% of activations but at 6% precision. Within that context it is gated by the models own policy logit at D2: it fires when choice (logit a1 - a2) > -2, i.e. the agent is not confidently committed to a2 (often after an unrewarded previous trial, prev_reward==0 holds 89% of mass, and when chose_good==0 i.e. S1 is actually the good state). Adding choice > -2 gives dev P 0.60 / R 0.72 / F1 0.65 / mass recall 0.80. Never fires at D1/GO, on a1 trials, on common transitions, or on a2->S2. Higher activations are somewhat more likely after unrewarded previous trials and switch trials; top examples are a2->S1 rare after a run of unrewarded trials. All variables are observed at D2 (no future variables).
